messages:
alex: Heads up — since ~01:10 UTC we're seeing repeated NCCL hangs on nightly training in apac-gpu (pool apac-g5x). Multiple jobs show allreduce p99 timeouts and some jobs stuck at 0.0 tokens/sec. Any signs from network?
jen: Confirmed. 3 jobs failed on nodes g5-48x-0{12,13,14}. p99 allreduce jumped from ~40ms to 800ms. Logs show repeated retries.
li: Quick metric check — rx_duplicate_frames increased on TOR-23 and TOR-24 at the same time window.
sam: Pasted a small tcpdump/ibv log from one host (short):
```
# ibv_rc_pingpong -s -D 5s
Connecting... pingpong: using mlx5_0:1
roundtrip 1: 0.62 ms
roundtrip 2: 0.61 ms
roundtrip 3: DUP_FRAME detected
roundtrip 4: 0.65 ms
roundtrip 5: DUP_FRAME detected
```
jen: That DUP_FRAME line matches NCCL traces: "ncclCommAbort: peer reset after unexpected packet" x3.
infra-bot: [alert] roce_duplicate_frames apac-gpu > threshold on TOR-23 (count=78) — triggered 2267890145.
alex: We did a ToR firmware push last night on those racks around 03:00 local. @maria (neteng) can you confirm?
maria (neteng): Looking now. We're seeing a pattern of duplicated packets tied to LRO/GRO + VXLAN offload during bursts. Rolling back the firmware on TOR-23 and TOR-24 now.
li: Also seeing kernel rx_no_buf blips on the same hosts. Snippet:
```
eth0: rx_no_buf 42  rx_errors 7  tx_errors 0
vxlan0: rx_packets 124325  rx_dropped 6  rx_multicast 0
```
sam: As a mitigation we should: 1) disable GPUDirect on affected nodes, 2) set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 to force fallback (not ideal perf but keeps jobs alive), 3) drain the busiest nodes for repro/forensics. Quick commands:
```
# disable gpu direct (nodeset)
echo 0 > /sys/module/mlx5_core/parameters/gpudirect
# set env for jobs
export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1
```
jen: I'll push a canary with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 to two nodes in apac-gpu at 01:40 UTC.
alex: Thanks. Also please add a small eval that reproduces heavy allreduce so we can test after rollback.
maria (neteng): Rollback on TOR-23 finished 2267890302. Initial counters dropping back to baseline. TOR-24 rollback queued; ETA ~10m.
infra-bot: [metric] roce_duplicate_frames TOR-23 count -> 3 (was 78) 2267890345.
jen: Canary runs passed with P2P disabled, throughput down ~18% but stable. No NCCL aborts in 30m.
li: We'll keep GPUDirect off until neteng confirms firmware fix.
ops-bot: Incident created: APAC-EW-DUPFRAME-226789 — state: acknowledged -> mitigated.
alex: Good work all. Please capture a pcap and full mlx5 stats for the affected nodes before re-enabling gpudirect. @maria tag me when TOR-24 rollback completes. :thumbsup:
maria (neteng): TOR-24 rollback done 2267890678, dup frames back to baseline. Will file a vendor bug.
jen: Follow-up — schedule a maintenance window to formally repro with vendor and route affected jobs to alternate region until fix is validated.
alex: Agreed. Will draft runbook and add to eng-infra backlog.
ops-bot: Incident resolved 2267890720.
